name: Jixie Lianxin
source:
With the smoke of the world wars fading away and the bells of the new millennium ringing, people no longer worry about survival.
Energy, medicine, machinery... Researchers in various fields had come together to establish the International Science City, pushing human's science and technology to new heights.
Underneath the bright and warm appearance of the Science City, survival of the fittest is the cold rule, and only the true geniuses and the mightiest researchers are allowed to stay.

Chen Jing, a young researcher with his cleverness and hard work, finally entered the top laboratory of artificial intelligence in the International Science City.
However, what awaited him is a rank-and-yank system that chooses only the best of the best, and no one cares about the whereabouts of others.

Chen Jing's research encountered obstacles, and he knew that this was not the life he wanted to live.
Fortunately, a generous employer brought him another dream job.
With this opportunity, Chen Jing finally meets “the girl”...

[Translated from [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2980050/_/?l=schinese]Steam[/url]]
